provenance.notes: Always wear eye protection and gloves. Disconnect power and relieve water pressure before attempting any tools or pipe maintenance.

maintenanceSchedule.title: Safety & Battery Inspection
maintenanceSchedule.desc: Check battery voltage terminals for corrosion. Test fire/CO detectors. Run backup generator under load for 15 mins.

maintenanceSchedule.title: Tool Care & Roof Audit
maintenanceSchedule.desc: Sharpen axe blades, knives, and spades with files. Clean rust off steel tools and apply light motor oil coat. Clear roof valleys and gutters of silt.

maintenanceSchedule.title: Winterization & Filters
maintenanceSchedule.desc: Drain above-ground water pipes. Clean cistern intake screens. Inspect chimney flues for creosote build-up to prevent flue fires.

repairWorkflows.title: Patching a Small Roof Leak
repairWorkflows.body: Locate the leak inside during rain. Climb roof under dry conditions. Inspect corresponding area for cracked shingles or loose nails. Apply a generous layer of roofing sealant mastic under the loose shingle, press down, and cap exposed nail heads with mastic.

repairWorkflows.title: Replacing a Faucet Washer
repairWorkflows.body: Shut off the local water supply valve. Open faucet to drain remaining water. Unscrew the handle screw, pull handle off, and use a wrench to remove the valve stem. Unscrew the small screw at the bottom of the stem, replace the worn rubber washer with a matching new one, and reassemble.

repairWorkflows.title: Sharpening an Axe
repairWorkflows.body: Clamp the axe head firmly in a bench vise. Hold a flat mill file at the matching bevel angle (~25 degrees). Push the file away from the blade edge in smooth, forward strokes. Work one side until a burr forms, then flip the axe and file the other side. Finish by honing with an oiled whetstone.
checklist: File from bevel base toward edge
